    Pushpin resting -> Pushpin lifted clear of the surface and held
  • component spread the pushpin's flexible body
    the central ribbed section is compressed -> the central ribbed section is expanded/widened
  • object compress the pushpin body
    the full height of the object is reduced by squeezing the middle section
  • use-pose pose the pushpin for suction
    the object is held such that the top rim is perpendicular to a surface and the body is ready for downward pressure
  • use-pose pose the pushpin for insertion
    the object is held by the handle and top rim to align the central pin for downward movement
